about: Frozen routing test set, written on 2026-10-04 BEFORE any router code existed. Each question is labelled with the domain whose documents should answer it: 'rti', 'agriculture', or 'other' (outside both, e.g. ration cards, budgets, passports -- finance is not built yet, so finance questions are 'other' for now). 'also_ok' lists other answers that are acceptable for a genuinely two-sided question. The label is about the TOPIC, not whether the documents happen to contain the answer. 'plain' is ordinary casual questions; 'traps' are questions whose words point to the wrong domain (an RTI request about a farm scheme; a farm question that says 'appeal', 'information', 'right' or 'penalty'); 'other' is out of scope, several of them close to a domain; 'followups' carry earlier turns, and the label is for the latest message in that conversation. The router is also tested on the 71 real FAQ questions in ingest/incoming/questions/questions.json (domain 'general' = other) and on every question in eval/demo_questions.json (rti) and eval/agri_questions.json (agriculture). 'final' (32) was added on 2026-10-05, BEFORE the LLM router was run even once; it is scored only at the end, after any change to the router prompt. 'followups2' (18) was added on 2026-10-06, after a live follow-up ('what if i have a white ration card' after an RTI fee question) was declined, and BEFORE the router prompt was changed: 12 follow-ups that stay on the earlier topic although they mention something listed under 'other' (ration card, pension, certificate, land registration, electricity), and 6 real changes of subject that must still be 'other'. 'followups3' (8) was written on 2026-10-06 after followups2 had been used to compare router fixes, and before the chosen fix ran: a fresh check of the same kind (5 follow-ups that stay, 3 real changes of subject).
